top_signals.title: BlackRock See ‘Generational High Yields’ in Corporate Credit
top_signals.summary: BlackRock Inc. says current corporate bond yields offer a more resilient source of returns that doesn’t depend on expectations for falling interest rates or tighter spreads.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The Debate: Should you be fined for playing music on the bus?
top_signals.summary: Local authorities could be empowered to give out £100 fines to 'loudcasters' on buses. We hear the case for and against in this week's Debate
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: ¥4 billion in lottery proceeds to go to quake-hit Kumamoto
top_signals.summary: The money will be used for reconstruction projects in areas damaged by the powerful July 28 temblor.
